Definition: a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring
BiblicalUsage: mappâch is the breathing out of life, expiring, and it occurs once, in Job 11:20. There the hope of the wicked shall be as the giving up of the ghost, their last breath. The word is the end of hope itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mappâch warns me that a hope set on anything but God expires with the breath, and that my hope must be fixed where breath does not fail.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
